facts.fact: Leah 在夜里用念单词的方式安抚 Miri 的恐慌，一直念到她睡着
facts.anchor: muttered redolent and pelt and chicanery until I fell asleep

facts.fact: Miri 打给 Centre 的电话终于接通，对方说他们已有全部资料，不必再报编号
facts.anchor: but the voice interrupts to assure me they already have all the details they need

facts.fact: Miri 回忆第一次送 Leah 出海：她转头说话时错过了潜艇下沉，回头看只剩空海面
facts.anchor: I moved my eyes away from the water long enough to miss the ship going down

facts.fact: Centre 的送别会后 Leah 没有跟 Miri 回家，当晚起她再没回来
facts.anchor: After the Centre threw their going-away party I went home and Leah didn’t

facts.fact: 三周过后 Centre 来电称行程延误，并说艇上物资够撑几个月、氧气会持续再生
facts.anchor: the Centre called to tell me there had been a delay

facts.fact: 在 Poppy 家的派对上，Leah 的朋友 Allegra 坐到 Miri 身边说需要谈随时可以打给她
facts.anchor: You know you can call me if you need to talk about anything

facts.fact: Miri 在“太空丈夫”论坛读完吵架帖后用全大写回帖，指出冥王星已不是行星
facts.anchor: that Pluto was no longer a planet

facts.fact: 第五个月 Miri 开始认定 Leah 已死；她哭着打给 Sam，先说寄养的猫死了，随后承认那是编的
facts.anchor: I began to assume she was dead
